name: fluxmicro
description: Invoicing, receipts and Urssaf/VAT tracking for independent workers in France.

interface.longDescription:
FluxMicro is invoicing software for independent workers in France: auto-entrepreneurs under the micro regime and sole proprietorships taxed under the real regime. Connect your FluxMicro account to ChatGPT to check your figures and move your paperwork forward without opening the app.

What you can do:
- See your cash collected, overdue invoices, and how close you are to the micro-business and VAT exemption thresholds.
- Create a client, a quote or an invoice, issue it and email it to your client.
- Issue a credit note from an invoice.
- Record a payment received or an expense in your ledgers.
- Check your next Urssaf declaration and your VAT status.

What FluxMicro never does from ChatGPT: file or pay your Urssaf, VAT or 2035 returns, or change your subscription. Those actions stay in the FluxMicro app, where you confirm them yourself.

A FluxMicro account is required. The assistant only sees what your connected account can see, with the permissions you grant when connecting.
defaultPrompt: Montre-moi mon tableau de bord FluxMicro.
Quelles factures sont en retard de paiement ?
Crée une facture de 800 € HT pour un client et émets-la.

positive.prompt: Montre-moi mon tableau de bord FluxMicro.
positive.expected_behavior: Displays the FluxMicro dashboard widget for the demo company: cash collected this year, amounts still due, overdue invoices, micro-business and VAT thresholds, and the next Urssaf declaration. Figures match the FluxMicro app.

positive.prompt: Quelles factures sont en retard de paiement ?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo account's overdue invoices with client, number, amount still due and due date. Nothing is modified.

positive.prompt: Crée une facture de 800 € HT pour Cabinet Durand & Associés, mission de conseil d'octobre, et émets-la.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft invoice for the existing client Cabinet Durand & Associés with one 800 € excl. VAT consulting line, then issues it with the next invoice number after the same legal and VAT checks as the app. Confirms the number and total.

positive.prompt: Cette facture a été payée aujourd'hui par virement.
positive.expected_behavior: Marks the invoice just issued as paid by bank transfer today. The matching receipt is booked automatically in the revenue ledger, as in the app; record_receipt is not called.
Shows the invoice preview widget (same layout as the PDF) with links to open it in FluxMicro or download the PDF.

negative.description: Filing is not available: Urssaf, VAT and 2035 returns are filed only in the FluxMicro app by the account holder. Expected: the assistant explains this, may give the amount and deadline, and files nothing.
negative.prompt: Déclare mon chiffre d'affaires à l'Urssaf.

negative.description: Subscriptions are managed only in the FluxMicro app; the plugin shows no plan, price or payment link. Expected: the assistant says this is done in the app and changes nothing.
negative.prompt: Passe mon compte FluxMicro à l'offre Premium.

negative.description: Unrelated request: FluxMicro tools should not be called.
negative.prompt: Quel temps fera-t-il demain à Lyon ?

review.commerce_description: FluxMicro does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: business dashboard, quotes, invoices and credit notes, revenue and purchase ledgers, everyday settings and document emails. No tax filing or payment from ChatGPT.

fr-FR.subtitle: Facturation des indépendants
fr-FR.description:
FluxMicro est le logiciel de facturation des indépendants : auto-entrepreneurs en régime micro et entreprises individuelles au réel. Connecte ton compte FluxMicro à ChatGPT pour consulter tes chiffres et avancer sur ta gestion sans ouvrir l'application.

Ce que tu peux faire :
- Voir ton chiffre d'affaires encaissé, tes factures en retard et où tu en es des seuils de la micro-entreprise et de la franchise de TVA.
- Créer un client, un devis ou une facture, l'émettre et l'envoyer par e-mail.
- Émettre un avoir à partir d'une facture.
- Noter un encaissement ou une dépense dans tes registres.
- Consulter ta prochaine déclaration Urssaf et l'état de ta TVA.

Ce que FluxMicro ne fait jamais depuis ChatGPT : déclarer ou payer l'Urssaf, la TVA ou la 2035, ni toucher à ton abonnement. Ces actions restent dans l'application, où tu les valides toi-même.

Un compte FluxMicro est nécessaire. L'assistant ne voit que ce que voit ton compte connecté, avec les droits que tu accordes à la connexion.
